Hi Priya, the directory shows your MacBook Pro (DEV-0005) as compliant. It has no open issues, and its last check-in was 2026-11-11. The "not compliant" message and the Drive problem may be left over from an earlier state, or the Mac may have dropped out of Jamf.

Jamf marks a Mac non-compliant, and blocks Drive and VPN, in any of these cases:
- FileVault is off.
- macOS is more than one major version behind.
- The Mac hasn't checked in for 14 days.

To fix it, re-enroll the Mac:
1. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles and remove any old Larkspur profile.
2. Go to enroll.example.test in Safari and sign in.
3. Install the downloaded profile from System Settings.

Also check that FileVault is on. After re-enrolling, Drive should work again once the Mac checks in. If it still says non-compliant, reply here and I'll pass it to a human on the IT team.

- the vendor
- what data it would touch
